title: Towards Hierarchical Cyber Defense with Large Language Models: From Planning to Execution
abstract: arXiv:2610.00590v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: An autonomous cyber defender trained with reinforcement learning (RL) is typically tied to the network on which it was trained, limiting its ability to generalize as network scale changes. Hierarchical RL reduces decision complexity by separating strategic targeting from tactical execution, but it does not eliminate this retraining dependence. We investigate whether frozen, zero-shot large language models (LLMs) can provide retraining-free control in hierarchical cyber defense and how performance changes as LLM control is extended from planning to execution. We formulate a controller-agnostic planner-executor hierarchy in which the planner selects a subnet to defend over a fixed horizon and the executor selects defensive actions within that subnet. translated_title: 基于大语言模型的分层网络防御：从规划到执行
translated_abstract: 用强化学习（RL）训练的自主网络防御者通常与训练时所用的网络紧密绑定，限制了其随网络规模变化进行泛化的能力。分层强化学习通过将战略目标选择与战术执行分离来降低决策复杂性，但并未消除这种对重新训练的依赖。我们研究冻结的、零样本大语言模型（LLM）能否在分层网络防御中提供无需重新训练的控制，以及当LLM控制从规划层面扩展到执行层面时性能如何变化。我们构建了一个与控制器无关的规划器-执行器分层架构，其中规划器在固定时间范围内选择要防御的子网，执行器在该子网内选择防御动作。利用高保真度的Cyberwheel环境（其内置的自动化红队智能体映射到MITRE ATT&CK框架），我们比较了RL+RL、LLM+RL和LLM+LLM等配置的表现。
tldr: 该论文提出用冻结的零样本大语言模型替代强化学习构建规划器-执行器分层网络防御架构，实现无需重新训练的防御控制，并系统比较了RL+RL、LLM+RL和LLM+LLM三种配置在从规划到执行不同控制层级下的性能表现。
en_tdlr: This paper investigates whether frozen, zero-shot LLMs can provide retraining-free control in hierarchical cyber defense, formulating a controller-agnostic planner-executor hierarchy and comparing RL+RL, LLM+RL, and LLM+LLM configurations as LLM control extends from planning to execution.
